column1: # The hand review of constant -> header assignments (the misjudgment
# worklist, closed one name at a time).  Consumed by tools/build-kb.py at
# the `reviewed` rank -- the ONLY source of reviewed linkage.  A name
# this file does not cover and no page/reference/family sentence files
# stays in reports/constant-header-gaps.tsv; the old prefix-guess
# fallback (header_map) is never consulted for linkage again.
# scope=prefix      a name family (name cell is PREFIX_*)
# scope=value-base  names whose printed value is an expression on one
#                   base (name cell is the base token: RASBASE covers the
# verdict=approve   file the name in `header` (evidence_page is the page
#                   the review rests on, or this file for family
#                   knowledge the pages do not print)
# verdict=reject    the name must NOT be filed in any header -- sample
#                   identifiers, page typos, CRT constants.  It stays in
#                   the gaps worklist with this review as the reason.
# verdict=prefer    the corpus states CONFLICTING headers for the name
#                   (one CE version's page says X.h, another says Y.h);
#                   this row settles the tie and outranks the tie, and
# tools/build-kb.py) and were never consulted for these rows.

Page typo kept as printed: "VK_RONTROL 0xA3 Right CTRL" is VK_RCONTROL (0xA3). The row stays in kb/constants.tsv quoted; the typo name is never filed into a header.

The system-color family the GetSysColor pages list; those pages state Winuser.h. Applies to the COLOR_* names the system-color tables print.
The NERR_* network-error family the "Net Errors" tables print; the network error header is Lmerr.h (pinned w32api-cegcc lmerr.h defines the NERR_ family).
RasDial states: "Include Raserror.h for definitions of the RAS error codes." The RAS Error Values pages print their rows as RASBASE+n; the base expression ties the row to that family.
